stem:
Omar lines up four children left to right with heights $132\,\mathrm{cm}$, $148\,\mathrm{cm}$, $140\,\mathrm{cm}$, and $155\,\mathrm{cm}$. Each child calls out how many taller children stand in front of that child.

Which height-code sequence is correct?

options.text: The height-code is $0$, $1$, $2$, $3$, counting every child standing in front.
The height-code is $3$, $2$, $1$, $0$, counting taller children standing behind.
The height-code is $0$, $1$, $0$, $2$, adding the heights in centimetres step by step.

teacher.key_rationale: Counts of taller children in front: first 0; second sees 132 (shorter) so 0; third sees 148 taller so 1; fourth sees all shorter so 0. Sequence 0,0,1,0.
